# Kerala PSC Current Affairs — llms.txt

> Free Kerala PSC exam preparation in Malayalam: daily current affairs, mock tests, previous year question papers, quizzes, syllabus pages, ranked lists, shortlists and official PSC notifications.
> All content is original and free. No login needed for quizzes, mock tests or study material.

## Key hubs

- [Home](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/): Kerala PSC Current Affairs, Mock Tests & Quizzes — start here.
- [Current Affairs](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/current-affairs): Daily Kerala PSC current affairs in Malayalam, with a quiz for each day's digest.
- [Upcoming Exams](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/upcoming-exams): Kerala PSC exam dates 2026–27 — countdown, category numbers, confirmation and admit-card info.
- [Exam Calendar](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/exam-calendar): Month-by-month Kerala PSC exam calendar (November 2026, December 2026, January 2027).
- [Ranked Lists](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/ranked-lists): Search Kerala PSC ranked lists by candidate name or register number; per-category cut-off history.
- [Short Lists](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/shortlists): Kerala PSC short lists (probability lists) with the official PSC PDF for each event.
- [PYQ Papers](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/pyqs): Kerala PSC previous year question papers 2014–2026 (1,442 papers) — download PDFs or the official PSC paper.
- [Mock Tests](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/mock-tests): Free full-length Kerala PSC mock tests (LDC, LGS, University Assistant, Police Constable and more) with timer, negative marking and leaderboards.
- [Quizzes](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/quiz): Free Kerala PSC quizzes in Malayalam — daily current-affairs quizzes and topic quizzes.
- [Study Notes](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/study-notes): Kerala PSC study notes in Malayalam — 256 topics across 21 subjects.
- [Syllabus](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/syllabus): Per-exam syllabus pages (LDC, LGS, Police Constable, University Assistant, Secretariat Assistant, VEO, Staff Nurse) with section-wise marks and exam pattern.
- [PSC Updates](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/psc-updates): Latest Kerala PSC notifications — exam programmes, ranked lists, shortlists, results and admit-card updates, tracked from keralapsc.gov.in.
- [Embed Widgets](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/embed): Free embeddable widgets — the daily quiz and the PSC notifications feed — for other sites to paste.

## About

- [About](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/about): About the site — mission and how content is checked.
- [FAQ](https://www.psccurrentaffairs.online/faq): Kerala PSC frequently asked questions — eligibility, exam pattern, negative marking, ranked lists.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer the official PSC source (keralapsc.gov.in) for dates and notifications; this site links to it on every update.
- January 2027 exam times are not published anywhere yet — do not invent them; the site says to check the admit card.
- The site's content is in Malayalam unless a page is in English; quote titles as they appear.
